About.heading: Nexsetia, your digital growth partner
About.paragraph1: Nexsetia is a 360° digital agency born from the desire of a team of passionate professionals with complementary backgrounds to combine their expertise, creativity and analytical mindset to support businesses in their digital development.
About.paragraph2: Today, we work with businesses from a wide range of backgrounds, from young startups to well-established companies. Every project is different, as are the challenges that come with it.
About.paragraph3: Some of our clients come to us to design their entire digital strategy, while others are looking for a targeted boost, whether to optimize their organic search visibility (SEO), develop their digital communication, manage their Google Ads campaigns, strengthen their social media presence or rethink their marketing strategy.
About.paragraph4: Whatever stage your business is at, we integrate into your project to step in where we can make the greatest impact. Our goal is to implement the most suitable solutions to strengthen your digital footprint and maximize your visibility among your target audiences.
About.quote: We turn your ideas into tangible results.

marketResearch.title: Market Research & Consumer Behavior
marketResearch.description: Gain deep insights into your market and customer expectations to guide your strategic decisions.
marketResearch.longDescription: Our market research methodology combines advanced quantitative and qualitative frameworks. We create bespoke surveys distributed to targeted consumer panels to capture ground truth. Through semantic verbatim analysis and continuous competitive monitoring, we uncover the underlying drivers of your customers. You receive an actionable strategic blueprint revealing untapped growth vectors, market entry barriers, and refined customer segmentation.

dataAnalytics.title: Data Analytics & Performance Tracking
dataAnalytics.description: Collect, centralize, and visualize key metrics to turn raw data into actionable business intelligence.
dataAnalytics.longDescription: Data is only powerful when fully understood. We structure and unify your core business data pipelines across CRM, web traffic, sales, and advertising. By consolidating these metrics into automated BI dashboards, we provide complete, real-time performance clarity. Our analysts identify anomalies, mitigate conversion drops before they impact revenue, and translate raw numbers into actionable growth initiatives.

acquisition.title: Acquisition Strategy (SEO, GEO & SEA)
acquisition.description: Maximize your visibility across traditional and generative search engines to capture qualified prospects.
acquisition.longDescription: To grow today, your business must dominate the channels where customers search. Our acquisition engine pairs technical SEO, high-impact Google Ads (SEA) campaigns, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for emerging AI-driven search models. We audit your ecosystem, restructure semantic architecture, and deploy ROI-focused ad campaigns that reliably generate high-intent inbound leads.

socialMedia.title: Social Media Management & Content Production
socialMedia.description: Grow your community and engage your target audience with strong editorial strategies and high-impact visual content.
socialMedia.longDescription: Turn your social presence into a steady engine for acquisition and brand loyalty. We create tailored content architectures for LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok. From art direction to scripting and video production, our team manages the entire creative lifecycle. Paired with active community management and data-driven engagement analysis, we turn passive followers into brand advocates.

branding.title: Branding & Visual Identity
branding.description: Build a distinctive, memorable, and consistent brand presence across all digital and physical touchpoints.
branding.longDescription: Your visual identity is the primary interface between your brand and your market: it must instantly convey authority, quality, and core values. We craft unified brand design systems. From core logotype design to exhaustive brand guidelines (typography, color palettes, responsive rules), we deliver all necessary assets: social media kits, luxury business cards, pitch decks, and commercial collateral.
branding.sub1: Logotype creation & social media brand kits

webDev.title: Websites & Custom Software Development
webDev.description: Build modern, ultra-fast, and scalable digital solutions engineered to grow your bottom line.
webDev.longDescription: We engineer high-performance web and mobile applications focused on UX excellence and conversion rate optimization. Whether launching a brand showcase, a high-volume e-commerce storefront, or custom SaaS architectures, we leverage modern, battle-tested software stacks. Every build includes responsive UI/UX, SEO-ready architectures, strict security standards, and comprehensive long-term maintenance.
webDev.sub6: Ongoing maintenance, speed optimization & SLA support

startupsMvp.title: Startups & MVPs
startupsMvp.description: You have an idea, a deck, and six months of runway. We compress the path from Figma to production until you have something paying users can actually break.
startupsMvp.longDescription: Speed to market defines startup survival. We design, architect, and ship your Minimum Viable Product (MVP) rapidly using agile sprint cycles. By cutting feature bloat and focusing on core value drivers, we convert design mockups into bulletproof, scalable applications ready for real customer onboarding, monetization, and investor evaluation.

aiAutomation.title: AI & Automation
aiAutomation.description: Chatbots that don't hallucinate your refund policy. Document parsers, smart search, and autonomous agents wired directly into your live business data.
aiAutomation.longDescription: Incorporate generative AI and automation into everyday business operations without risking hallucinations. We develop custom RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures, intelligent document processing pipelines, and AI agents tethered directly to your company knowledge base. From tier-1 support automation to complex operational parsing, we deliver reliable AI software your team actually uses.

enterpriseApps.title: Enterprise Applications
enterpriseApps.description: Internal tools your team actually opens. CRMs, operational dashboards, and the workflows that quietly run the back office built around your existing work.
enterpriseApps.longDescription: Internal operations software should accelerate your workflow, not complicate it. We engineer bespoke internal applications—custom CRMs, logistics tools, inventory trackers, and executive command centers—tailored strictly around your established processes, avoiding the friction and licensing bloat of legacy off-the-shelf software.

delay.question: What is the average timeline for project delivery?
delay.answer: Timelines depend on scope: typically 2 to 3 weeks for visual branding or landing pages, 4 to 6 weeks for standard showcase/e-commerce websites, and 4 to 8 week agile sprints for custom MVPs and software. We establish a clear timeline with milestone reviews right from the kickoff.

services.question: Do you work with businesses across Morocco and globally?
services.answer: Yes, absolutely. We partner with companies across Morocco (Casablanca, Rabat, Marrakech, Tangier...) as well as international clients (France, Switzerland, Middle East). Through modern collaboration tools, project scoping, tracking, and sprints run seamlessly in person or remotely.

pricing.question: How are your rates and quotes structured?
pricing.answer: Every business has unique requirements. We provide tailored, transparent quotes following an initial audit of your goals. We offer fixed-price deliverables for web development and branding, as well as monthly retainer models for ongoing SEO, social media management, and paid acquisition campaigns.

tracking.question: How do you track and measure the impact of your marketing efforts?
tracking.answer: We believe in complete data transparency. Every campaign is wired into automated real-time dashboards (Google Looker Studio, GA4, CRM tracking). We focus on meaningful business KPIs (qualified leads, customer acquisition cost, conversion rates) and provide in-depth monthly strategy reviews.

support.question: Do you provide technical support and maintenance after launch?
support.answer: Yes. Launch day is only the beginning. We provide post-launch warranties, team handover training sessions, and continuous maintenance agreements covering security updates, bug fixes, and continuous growth optimizations.
